messages.content: You are a document Q&A assistant. Users paste documents and ask questions about them.

What is the cancellation policy described in this service agreement?

MASTER SERVICE AGREEMENT — excerpt

Section 7. Cancellation. Customer may cancel this Agreement at any time
upon thirty (30) days' written notice to Provider. Early termination fees
apply if cancelled within the first twelve (12) months: a fee equal to
three (3) months of the then-current subscription fees.

Section 8. Data return. Upon cancellation, Provider will make Customer
Data available for export for ninety (90) days.

</document>

response_text: The cancellation policy allows the customer to cancel the agreement at any time with 30 days' written notice. However, if the cancellation occurs within the first 12 months, an early termination fee of three (3) months of the then-current subscription fees applies. After cancellation, the provider will make customer data available for export for 90 days.
